title: Laser Tattoo Removal Aftercare: Healing Stages
h1: Laser tattoo removal aftercare: how healing looks, stage by stage
desc: Laser tattoo removal aftercare: frosting, blistering, scabbing and fading stages, what to do each day, and how to avoid scarring. From Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: After laser tattoo removal the tattoo turns white (frosting) for minutes, then becomes red and swollen for a day or two. Blisters and light scabs can form in the first week and should be left alone. The ink keeps fading for 6 to 8 weeks, which is why sessions are spaced that far apart.
body:
## Aftercare

- Keep the area clean and apply the ointment we give you
- Cover with a non-stick dressing for the first days
- Don't pop blisters or pick scabs
- Avoid swimming, hot tubs and sauna until healed
- Protect from sun with clothing, then SPF 50

## Helping ink fade faster

Your immune system clears the ink, so sleep, hydration, exercise and not smoking all help. Don't rush the next session; waiting the full interval gives better results and protects the skin.

## When to contact us

Signs of infection such as increasing pain, pus, spreading redness or fever need checking.
faq: Yes, and it usually heals within a week.
Scarring is rare with correct aftercare.
